name: ThinkingBox
summary: Microsoft's open-source sandbox and benchmark that runs agents against isolated MCP tool servers and grades the backend state and side effects they leave.
description: ThinkingBox defines tools as MCP servers, runs an LLM agent (with a simulated user) through stateful scenarios and test cases, and checks terminal database state, side effects and response requirements instead of the agent's own claims. ThinkingBox-Bench has 507 stateful business workflows, each run 20 times to measure consistency (paper: "One Success Isn't Reliability", arXiv 2608.19741). An OpenEnv adapter (openenv/OpenEnv envs/thinkingbox_env) exposes the pinned public benchmark through the standard reset/step interface for evaluation. Also usable for training-data generation and RL loops. MIT.
